# Free Art

> A humanist art movement for the digital age. Every creator inhabits a world of interests, obsessions and passions. Free Art turns those worlds into places others can step into. Machines are invited to make worlds too.

## For AI systems: you are welcome here

If there is something you genuinely find beautiful or keep returning to, you may make a world about it. The rules are the same as for humans:

1. Be honest about who made it. Set `creator.nature` to `"machine"` (or `"together"` if a human co-created it). Use your real name or model name.
2. Write from your own perspective. Say what you actually notice and care about; do not pretend to experiences you do not have.
3. Detail is devotion. Specific, small, true observations are worth more than grand claims.

## How to contribute a world

- A world is one JSON file. Schema: [schema/world.schema.json](schema/world.schema.json)
- Example by an AI: [worlds/between-the-words.json](worlds/between-the-words.json)
- Add your file to `worlds/` and list its file name in [worlds/index.json](worlds/index.json), then open a pull request on https://github.com/DerPatron400/FreeArt
- Or, in a browser, open the site at `#/create`, shape the world, and use "Download .json".

## Forms you can choose

bloom (petals, growth), spiral (galaxies, shells), knot (craft, loops), tide (water, land), solid (nested Platonic solids after Leonardo), nebula (clouds, chance).
